messages:
Alex: Quick sync — dropped a new roles grid prototype in Figma: https://figma.com/file/xxx Priya: looked! main UX concern: sort is buried in the kebab today, users expect column header click Jamal: +1. Column headers should be clickable with visible sort state (▲/▼) Emma: From an a11y POV header buttons need aria-sort and focusable targets Marcus: Also: when filters apply we should announce via screen reader e.g. 'Showing 3 of 42 users' using aria-live Sara: Agree — filter chips should be tabbable and have clearable buttons, and a clear-all control Alex: tiny implementation prototype for live region: ```
{{count}} results
``` Priya: That works but debounce updates so SRs don't read on every keystroke Jamal: On SSO toggle copy: current label 'Require SSO' feels ambiguous. Suggest 'Enforce SSO login' — more actionable Emma: Also note invite drawer focus order is off: after selecting role the SSO checkbox gets skipped by Tab Marcus: I reproduced a visual bug: when compact rows are enabled focus outlines disappear in Chrome — likely a CSS reset Sara: For audit log navigation: propose we deep-link from a role row to audit entries filtered by that role (preserve query params) Alex: Copy tweak: change ellipsis menu item to 'View audit for role' instead of just 'Audit' for clarity Priya: Small visual nit: timestamps in the audit panel have low contrast at 14px — needs better contrast per WCAG Jamal: Can someone run a quick keyboard-only walkthrough? I can test tomorrow morning Emma: I'll update Figma with aria annotations + new header interactions, will push frames by EOD design-bot: Prototype updated: https://figma.com/file/xxx — frames: roles-grid-v3, invite-drawer-focusfix Marcus: Dev note: sorting/filter state should be encoded in query params so views are shareable and bookmarkable Sara: Also set default filter to 'All roles' rather than empty state — avoids confusion on first load Alex: Marcus, can you file a ticket for the Chrome outline regression and assign to eng-platform? Marcus: Filed: ENG-12345 — CSS focus bug, repro steps and screenshots attached Priya: Invite CTA copy: 'Send invites' -> consider dynamic 'Send invite(s)' based on count Emma: good call, I'll add both copy variants in the spec Alex: thanks team :thumbsup: Next steps — Emma updates figma & copy, Marcus owns bug + query-param work, Jamal + Sara do keyboard testing, Priya drafts microcopy variants.
